response.query: How can we derive a physics-informed fusion formula that combines RP-based regression, time-of-arrival travel-time estimates, and propagation-speed to output a calibrated distance-to-fault with uncertainty?
response.answer: Combine RP-based regression with time-of-arrival travel-time estimates and propagation-speed to derive a calibrated distance-to-fault. Use statistical methods to quantify uncertainty in the output. This fusion formula integrates physics principles for accurate fault distance estimation.
